generation.candidate_seed_policy: Each permanent candidate slot uses its fixed seed for Topology Planner, Semantic Planner, Structured Outputs fallback, and all correction calls.
generation.candidate_retry_policy: Three permanent candidate slots; maximum three complete top-level attempts per slot; accept the first adapter-valid ActivityGraph; never retry a successful slot; never inspect evaluation scores.
generation.planner_correction_policy: One initial response plus at most two validation corrections per planner stage.
generation.structured_output_policy: Attempt Structured Outputs first and preserve the existing JSON response-format fallback behavior.

evaluation.methodology: Existing frozen Friedrich semantic evaluation; no methodology or threshold changes.
evaluation.failure_policy: Failed candidates retain N/A Action, Flow, and Control-Flow/Structure metrics; successful candidates are never retried for model quality.

artifacts.collision_policy: Fail if either output root contains artifacts for a different run_id; resume only when the stored run_id and frozen identities match exactly.
artifacts.hash_policy: Record SHA-256 for every evaluated ActivityGraph and all run-identity inputs.
